newsitem.title: THAILAND: Samart Telcoms unit signs phone deal.
newsitem.headline: Samart Telcoms unit signs phone deal.

text.p: Thailand's Samart Telcoms Plc said on Wednesday its wholly-owned Samart Communication Service Co Ltd unit had won a government contract to install a telephone network in rural Thailand.

It said under the contract with the Telephone Organisation of Thailand (TOT), Samart Communication will install a satellite telephone network linking 1,342 stations that require 1.5-1.6 billion baht ($58-$62 million) of investment.
The network covering 2,013 villages nationwide is scheduled to be completed within 11 months, the company said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
Samart Communication is expected to receive about 450 million baht of revenue a year, or 4.2 billion baht during the 112-month contract, it said.
Samart Communication last year won a separate TOT contract to install 1,000 satellite telephone stations covering 1,475 villages. It did not detail the contract.
